title: Workout log
audience: For anyone training a few times a week who wants to see progress.
description: A free workout log in a note: log sets and runs, see your personal bests and progress, and what's next. Or tell your AI what you did.
seoTitle: Workout log template and app for ChatGPT and Claude
note:
Workout log

Set up your plan in the app, then log each session there. Or tell your AI what you did and it logs it and says if it was a personal best. Weights are in the units you pick in the app.

## Training notes
Ask your AI how your training is going, and its lines land here.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Workout log". It is an app, with its data in "Workout log.app/data.json". Read it with fetch before each change; change it with edit. If values.started isn't set, ask which workouts I do in turn and how often a week, then set values.plan, values.goal and values.started (today, yyyy-mm-dd). When I say what I did, add { id, date, name, workout, items } to values.sessions; each item is { exercise: an id in values.exercises (add new ones there), sets: [{ reps, kg }] or [{ km, min }] }, in kg and km even if values.units is lb. Then say if it beat my best (weight × (1 + reps / 30), or distance and pace). When I ask how I'm doing, add three lines under "Training notes".

asks: Ask which workouts I do and how often, unless I've already set it up, then set up my workout log.
Did 3x5 squats at 100 kg and a 5 km run in 28 minutes. Was that a best?
Am I getting stronger on bench?

args.old_string: Ask your AI how your training is going, and its lines land here.
args.new_string:
Ask your AI how your training is going, and its lines land here.
**Last four weeks:** 11 sessions of 12 planned. Squat went from 95 kg x 5 to 105 kg x 5, a new best on 4 November. Bench press has stayed at 70 kg x 6. Next: add 2.5 kg to bench every second Push day.
